metadata.description: Spend governance for AI agents: budgets, allowlists, human approval, and a signed audit log.

plugins.name: agentveins
plugins.description: Put a spend policy between your agent and its wallet. Budgets, vendor allowlists, human approval above a threshold, a kill switch, and a tamper-evident audit log — enforced by an MCP server that holds the key, so the agent cannot pay around it.
